$comment: Assets used by the tutorial samples. Fetched by tools/bootstrap.py into assets/, which is gitignored. Everything here is openly licensed; see CREDITS.md. Chapters add entries as they need them. The glTF models are fetched file by file from a pinned commit of KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets rather than by cloning it: the repository is several gigabytes and these chapters use two models from it.

assets.name: models/damaged_helmet
assets.description: Damaged Helmet: one mesh, one material, textures embedded in the .glb. The model chapters 3.1 and 3.2 load, and the one 3.3 reaches with --model because its single node carries a real transform.
assets.attribution: Damaged Helmet by ctxwing (2018), rebuilt and converted to glTF from an earlier model by theblueturtle_. The .glb fetched here is the CC-BY-4.0 rebuild.

assets.name: models/flight_helmet
assets.description: Flight Helmet: six meshes, six materials, separate textures. Chapters 3.3 and 3.4.
assets.attribution: Flight Helmet, converted from Maya by Gary Hsu (2018). Public domain.
